title: SHAP Sentiment Analysis Explanation
description: Load a pre-trained sentiment model and use SHAP to produce token-level attributions for five test sentences.

steps.description: Imports: transformers pipeline and shap libraries.
Test sentences: negation, sarcasm, positive, mixed, and ambiguous examples.
Predictions: sentiment analysis results for each sentence.
SHAP explanation: explainer creation, shap_values computation, and text plot for first sentence.
